scale_interval: Bar endpoints 400 um / (36 +/- 1) pixels; not a confidence interval.
morphology: Main 3x3 opening+closing largest component vs largest component without opening/closing.
LUT: Nearest vs second-nearest RGB colorbar match; JPEG and published pseudocolor uncertainty, not raw camera noise.
height_reference: Unverified crop-bottom origin; absolute top/bottom not an independent spatial fit constraint.
